title: Batch apply Queue series overrides
summary: Adds backend-owned current-queue TV series batch file override preview/apply routes plus Queue drawer modal controls.
reason: Operators need to stage file-override drawer settings once and apply them across the currently queued rows for the detected TV series without manually selecting every episode.
behavior_before: File override drawer changes could be saved only for the selected exact file. There was no current-queue series preview, no fingerprinted apply flow, and no batch metadata to distinguish protected manual rows from previous batch-created rows.
behavior_after: The Queue drawer can preview Apply to Series for the selected TV row, showing detected show root, proposed fields, affected rows, protected manual rows, issues, and blockers. Confirmed apply re-runs preview with a fingerprint, writes exact file overrides only for eligible current queue rows, protects exact manual overrides, and replaces prior batch-created exact overrides with backend-managed _batch metadata.
